name: the-glow-leaves-with-the-page-on-a-space-switch
description: Space Run holds a page that is blue over red, space Empty holds nothing. A switch to Empty clears the pane but leaves the strip's active tab where it was, so nothing re-runs the tint: the band beside the empty card keeps the red page's glow. Wanted: the band follows what the pane shows. On Empty it drops to the space tint, and on the return trip the glow comes back.

assertions.label: the-glow-left-with-the-page
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: the band beside the card moved when the page went away. A band that keeps the red page's colours over an empty space reads 0 here.

assertions.label: and-left-the-space-tint-behind
assertions.desc: The band beside the empty card reads the light space tint (about 178, what ambilight-off-leaves-the-space-alone reads). A cleared tint that stamped the band alpha on transparent black painted a 55% black band here and still passed the delta above.

assertions.label: and-came-back-with-it
assertions.desc: The return trip re-attaches the same tab without a strip notification, so the glow has to be restored by the same path that put the page back.
